statement.text: Let $p$ be a prime, and $P$ a finite $p$-group. (a) Suppose that $P$ has an abelian subgroup of order $p^n$. For which $n$ does $P$ necessarily have a normal abelian subgroup of order $p^n$? (b) Suppose that $P$ has an elementary abelian subgroup of order $p^n$. For which $n$ does $P$ necessarily have a normal elementary abelian subgroup of order $p^n$?
